subject.title: fix(agents): decouple MCP retirement from browser cleanup

question: Should `OpenClawPluginToolContext.runId` become a supported optional public SDK field for ephemeral per-run resource ownership?
rationale: The browser fix uses the field cleanly, but adding a public plugin context identifier creates a durable third-party contract that automated review cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve the narrow contract
options.body: Keep `runId` optional and opaque with the documented non-persistence and non-security restrictions, then require real-browser proof before merge.

options.title: Keep ownership browser-private
options.body: Replace the public context field with a browser-specific host/runtime ownership seam so third-party plugins do not receive a new general identifier.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Do not merge the broader lifecycle system if the public contract and coordination complexity are not worth supporting.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Keep `runId` optional and opaque with the documented non-persistence and non-security restrictions, then require real-browser proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows the strongest sustained ownership across subagent cleanup, MCP retirement, lazy loading, and plugin-facing lifecycle surfaces.
